source.title: You can have 'em: Six big-name players I'll be passing on in drafts
source.author: Liz Loza
source.summary: Identifies six expensive veterans or stars whose injury, efficiency, role, or touchdown risks outweigh their current draft prices.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Loza is passing at QB5 cost because Cincinnati's line, Burrow's limited rushing, and his injury history weaken the value.
takeaways.rationale: Loza is passing at QB5 cost because Cincinnati's line, Burrow's limited rushing, and his injury history weaken the value.
risks: Role, health, team context, and draft price can change before the season.
